ITEM 1 | Wedge-shaped piece of flatbread-like crust, golden-tan with pale cream interior, topped with a dark reddish-brown minced filling with green flecks and a thin orange-red sauce layer, about 9 cm long and 4 cm wide at the widest, roughly 1.5 cm thick, lying at the upper edge of the plate | 85
ITEM 2 | Round slice of yellow corn cob, about 4.5 cm diameter and 2.5 cm thick, bright yellow kernels with pale cut surface and visible kernel rows, dry-looking, sitting alone on the left side of the plate | 40
ITEM 3 | Loose cluster of cooked chickpeas, tan-beige, smooth, slightly glossy and firm, scattered across the plate with a dense pile on the lower right, individual pieces about 1 cm across | 110
ITEM 4 | Sautéed mixed vegetables with soft translucent onion-like pieces, small diced red bell pepper pieces, and pale yellow kernels, slightly glistening with oil, about 6 cm across, piled beside the chickpeas on the lower right | 45
ITEM 5 | Fresh dark green leafy greens, a few whole leaves with thin stems, slightly wilted, placed on top of the vegetable pile on the right side | 10
ITEM 6 | Thin light oily sheen and small orange-red pieces of diced pepper and sauce residue scattered among the vegetables and chickpeas, minimal volume | 5
